answer: A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 18 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a nadir bet on surviving 55 epochs of grading, and every quartz settlement recomputes the walnut schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 55 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 29 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
